application_precondition: Future receipt is an expected object only; no actual file exists until separately authorized exact shared application succeeds.
execution: No included scripts, source, builds, project tests, runtime or cloud calls executed.
git_modes: Git retains only executable bits; exact original/publication filesystem modes recorded per raw input.
manifest_self_hash: External publication-paths registry and SHA256SUMS cover generated metadata; avoids self-reference.
